description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions on Meta Llama 4 Scout, multimodal (image input) with tool calling. Set your OpenAI SDK base URL to https://agents.citiviewgroup.com/v1/llama4 and pay per token with x402 instead of an API key: $0.81 per million input and $2.55 per million output tokens, minimum $0.002 a call, at most $0.0145. The 402 quotes your request's maximum; "upto" payers are charged only the tokens used. Same request/response shape as OpenAI (tool calling, image input, streaming supported), up to 2048 output tokens. Costs $0.0145 USDC per call (x402).
